industriesSection.title: Built around the way service businesses work
industriesSection.body: Whether your business runs on scheduled appointments, walk-ins, or a mix of both, TejoTime keeps booking, providers, and clients organized without adding complicated software.

features.title: Everything you need to run a smoother day
features.body: Give clients an easy way to book, keep appointments and optional walk-ins in one place, and stay on top of the day from your phone.

booking.title: Let clients book without the back-and-forth
booking.body: Your TejoTime booking page is open 24/7. Clients can pick a service, choose a provider, and reserve an available time in just a few taps. No phone tag. No back-and-forth DMs.

walkins.title: Appointments and walk-ins, together
walkins.body: Scheduled appointments and the walk-in waitlist live in one view. Add a walk-in, start a service, and everyone sees an honest estimated wait.

clients.title: Know your clients before they arrive
clients.body: Visit history and notes stay with the client, not with whoever happened to serve them. Reminders go out on their own, and rebooking happens at the chair.

Independent and small multi-provider businesses in beauty, wellness, therapy, body art, and pet care — salons, barbershops, nail studios, spas, med spas, massage, physical therapy, tattoo studios, and pet groomers.

privacy.metaDescription: How TejoTime collects and uses information in the owner app and related services.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. Who this app is for
paragraphs: TejoTime is a business tool for shop owners and staff (salons, barbershops, spas and similar). It is not directed at children under 13.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: Account: owner or staff phone number and password; name, role, and store details you enter.

Business content you add: store name, address, hours, services, prices, photos, staff names and photos; customer names, phone numbers, visit and appointment history you or your customers provide when they book or join the queue.

Device and technical: login tokens stored securely on the device; app version and basic device or network information needed to run the service; photos you choose to upload (staff or store images). We only access the photo library when you pick an image. We do not take photos in the background.
We do not collect precise GPS location, contacts, SMS, or payment card numbers in this app. Customers pay at the shop.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use this information to create and sign in to your account; run your queue, appointments, calendar and customer list; show your public booking page; send operational updates related to your store (for example queue or booking status); and to secure the service, prevent abuse, and provide support.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. We share it only with hosting and storage providers that run our servers and image storage, under contract; when required by law; and with people you invite (staff logins) for that store.
Your public booking page may show the store name, address, services, prices and photos you publish.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
paragraphs: We keep account and store data while the store is active. You may ask us to delete a store or account by emailing support@tejotime.com. Some records may be kept if the law requires it.

sections.heading: 6. Security
paragraphs: Passwords are stored hashed. Session tokens are kept in the device secure store. No method is 100% secure.

sections.heading: 7. Your choices
paragraphs: You can update store and customer data in the app. You can sign out. You can request access, correction or deletion of your account data at support@tejotime.com.

sections.heading: 8. Children’s privacy
paragraphs: The app is for business users, not children. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The “Last updated” date will change. Continued use means you accept the updated policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
paragraphs: TejoTime. Email: support@tejotime.com. Phone: +91 79907 17045. Website: https://www.tejotime.com
